meta.story: Bablu ka Hotel EP3 haazri: staff call in absent, paper attendance register is a mess, Kaka shows phone clock-in, leave queue, payslips and documents in your own Drive (HR4U)
meta.hook: Stop counting staff in a register.

beats.headline: Stop counting staff in a register.
beats.say: Kaun aaya, kaun nahi... is register se kuch pata hi nahi chalta!

beats.label: 1 · CLOCK IN FROM THE PHONE
beats.headline: One tap. You see live who's in.

beats.label: PRIYA · 9:02 AM
beats.say: Good morning sir! Haazri lag gayi.

beats.label: 3 · PAYSLIPS IN ONE CLICK
beats.headline: Month end: every payslip, one click.
beats.say: aur salary slip, ek click mein.

beats.label: 4 · FILES IN YOUR OWN GOOGLE DRIVE
beats.say: Aur saare kagaz... contract, ID, salary slip... sab teri apni Google Drive mein, beta.

beats.label: SEND THIS TO AN OWNER WITH A REGISTER
beats.say: Ab pata hai kaun aaya, kaun nahi. Mahine ke aakhir mein, bas ek click!

beats.label: SUTRIXA HR4U
beats.headline: Attendance, leave, payslips. One app. hr4u.sutrixa.com
